Name: AutoHideHost - Instant Sleep for Multiplayer
Author: LeeKit9989
Description:
[b]AutoHideHost - The Ultimate Dedicated Server Mod[/b]

A reliable companion for running 24/7 Stardew Valley multiplayer servers.
AutoHideHost solves three major issues in multiplayer: waiting for sleeping players, host player interference, and wasted server resources when nobody is online.

[b]What's New in v1.2.2[/b]
[b]FIXED: Disabled Automatic LevelUpMenu Handling[/b]
In previous versions, the mod automatically closed LevelUpMenu, which prevented players from choosing skill professions. This has now been corrected.

Changes in this version:
[list]
[*] Players can manually choose skill professions
[*] ShippingMenu and DialogueBox auto-handling remains active
[*] Instant day transition once all players confirm choices
[*] No unintended automatic selections
[/list]

Technical notes:
[list]
[*] Removed LevelUpMenu from auto-dismiss logic
[*] Instant sleep trigger preserved after manual menu closure
[*] Full compatibility with Always On Server maintained
[/list]

[b]Core Features[/b]

[b]1) Instant Sleep (No Waiting)[/b]
Vanilla multiplayer requires all players to sleep before ending the day. AutoHideHost removes this limitation.

Features:
[list]
[*] Any player can sleep at any time
[*] Day ends immediately when all online players are in bed
[*] Transition time under 0.5 seconds
[*] Single-player-like experience
[*] Full profession selection support (v1.2.2+)
[/list]

Technical details:
[list]
[*] Sleep status monitored every 0.25 seconds
[*] Uses Team Ready API for sync
[*] Auto-handles ShippingMenu and DialogueBox
[*] LevelUpMenu requires manual confirmation
[/list]

[b]2) Invisible Host Player[/b]
Designed for dedicated servers where the host player is a technical necessity.

Functionality:
[list]
[*] Host warped to Desert (0,0) by default
[*] Invisible and non-interactive to other players
[*] Auto-hide on save load and on each new day
[*] Protection from forced teleports
[/list]

Guard Window:
[list]
[*] Engine may teleport host to Farm on player connect
[*] Mod detects this and re-hides host instantly
[*] Active for 60 seconds after connection; refreshes daily
[/list]

Hide methods:
[list]
[*] warp — send host to a defined map location (default: Desert)
[*] offmap — send host to extreme coordinates
[/list]

[b]3) Smart Auto-Pause[/b]
Works with Always On Server to conserve resources.
[list]
[*] Auto-pauses when no players are online
[*] Resumes instantly when someone joins
[*] Reduces CPU/RAM usage and bandwidth
[*] Prevents unwanted time progression
[/list]

[b]Perfect For[/b]
[list]
[*] 24/7 servers (VPS/Cloud/Home)
[*] Docker deployments
[*] Cross-platform multiplayer
[*] Groups in different time zones
[*] Avoiding AFK delays
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]

Requirements:
[list]
[*] SMAPI 4.0.0+
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6.0+
[*] Server/Host only (clients do not need it)
[/list]

Steps:
[list]
[*] Install SMAPI
[*] Download AutoHideHost v1.2.2
[*] Extract to Stardew Valley/Mods/
[*] Launch via SMAPI
[/list]

[b]Configuration[/b]

Edit: Mods/AutoHideHost/config.json

[code]
{
"Enabled": true,
"AutoHideOnLoad": true,
"AutoHideDaily": true,
"PauseWhenEmpty": false,
"InstantSleepWhenReady": true,
"HideMethod": "warp",
"WarpLocation": "Desert",
"WarpX": 0,
"WarpY": 0,
"PreventHostFarmWarp": true,
"PeerConnectGuardSeconds": 60,
"RehideDelayTicks": 1,
"DebugMode": false,
"DebugTraceMenus": false
}
[/code]

Options:
[list]
[*] Enabled — master switch
[*] AutoHideOnLoad — hide host on save load
[*] AutoHideDaily — re-hide each new day
[*] InstantSleepWhenReady — instant sleep when all ready
[*] HideMethod — warp/offmap
[*] WarpLocation — target location name
[*] WarpX/WarpY — coordinates
[*] PreventHostFarmWarp — guard window protection
[*] PeerConnectGuardSeconds — guard duration (default 60)
[*] DebugMode — extended logging
[/list]

[b]Recommended Companion Mods[/b]
[list]
[*] Always On Server — automates host actions, enables 24/7 uptime (full integration)
[*] ServerAutoLoad — auto-loads save on restart (works together)
[*] Skill Level Guard — prevents forced Level 10 skills (recommended)
[/list]

[b]Docker Server Integration[/b]
AutoHideHost is included in the Puppy Stardew Server setup.

One-command deployment:
[code]
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/truman-world/puppy-stardew-server/main/quick-start.sh | bash
[/code]

Features:
[list]
[*] Cross-platform
[*] One-command deploy
[*] Auto-save load
[*] VNC configuration
[*] 2GB RAM minimum
[*] Pre-configured mods (v1.2.2)
[/list]

[b]FAQ[/b]

[b]Q: Works with existing saves?[/b]
A: Yes.

[b]Q: Do clients need this mod?[/b]
A: No, server/host only.

[b]Q: Can players choose skill professions?[/b]
A: Yes, starting from v1.2.2.

[b]Q: Compatible with other mods?[/b]
A: Works with major mods including Always On Server, ServerAutoLoad, Content Patcher, SVE.

[b]Q: How to confirm it works?[/b]
A: SMAPI console will show:
[code]
[AutoHideHost] AutoHideHost v1.2.2 loaded
[AutoHideHost] Host auto-hidden
[AutoHideHost] Guard window active
[/code]

[b]Q: Can I re-enable automatic LevelUpMenu dismissal?[/b]
A: Possible via source modifications, but not recommended.
